item.summary: fix(install): propagate Linux build-tool failures instead of claiming success (#123817) install_build_tools_linux ran run_quiet_step and then returned 0 unconditionally from every package-manager branch, so a failed build-tool install was printed as an error and immediately overwritten with a success line. The installer emitted "Installing build tools failed" followed by "Build tools installed", and the caller's "Continuing without auto-installing build tools" warning was unreachable. The npm-failure recovery path likewise reported "Build tools setup complete" and retried an install that could not succeed. install_build_tools_macos already propagated its status; only the Linux sibling swallowed it. Return the package manager's exit status and collapse the five duplicated is_root/sudo branches into one command list, which removes the bug class rather than patching a single branch. Verified against the live openclaw.ai script: a stubbed apt-get failure reproduced the false success before the change and reports the honest warning after it.
